messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "8 mg oral dose for patients 12 years and older"
set: ["8 mg oral dose for patients 12 years and older", "pediatric patients 12 years and older with depression", "600 mg 3 times a day for patients 12 years and older", "300 mg 3 times a day for patients 12 years and older", "4 mg oral dose for patients aged 4 to 11 years", "10 mg or 20 mg per day for children and adolescents aged 8 and older", "8 mg for MEC", "8 mg", "8 mg twice a day every 12 hours", "8 mg orally every 8 hours after the first dose", "lower than normal dose for older adults", "10 mg subcutaneously once a week for children 10 years and older with Type 2 Diabetes", "children with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia: 20 mg once daily for those 7 years of age and older", "children with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia: 5 mg to 20 mg once daily for those 10 years of age and older", "40 mg/kg/day for patients 3 to 4 years of age", "40 mg orally once a day for up to 8 weeks"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
